name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-50EM 'Thunderbolt'
description:
The VS-50EM Thunderbolt is Volkov-Saito's electromagnetic precision rifle, combining their signature accuracy obsession with dual-stage magnetic acceleration. The weapon fires 4mm tungsten-ceramic composite penetrators at velocities that create a brief visible plasma trail in humid conditions. Each penetrator arrives at the target with energy sufficient to defeat any personal armor system in production.

Unlike Arcturus' Gauss, which prioritizes silence, the Thunderbolt prioritizes accuracy. Volkov-Saito's weapon-learning system integrates with the electromagnetic acceleration, building a precise model of each individual weapon's coil characteristics to deliver penetrators with velocity consistency measured in single meters per second. This consistency, combined with the aerodynamic stability of the tungsten-ceramic penetrator, produces sub-quarter-MOA accuracy at 1,000 meters.

The Thunderbolt costs Φ40,000 and requires a dedicated power cell worn as a backpack that provides 25 shots per charge. The weapon is sold exclusively to vetted customers through Volkov-Saito's precision division, with each unit individually serial-matched to its buyer. Resale requires Volkov-Saito's authorization. These restrictions have not prevented the Thunderbolt from appearing on the black market, where units command Φ80,000 or more.
specifications:
caliber: 4mm tungsten-ceramic penetrator
effective_range: 1,000m
rate_of_fire: 20 rpm (capacitor-limited)
magazine_capacity: 25 penetrators per charge
weight: 5.5 kg (rifle) + 3.0 kg (power cell backpack)
tactical_use: The Thunderbolt delivers the most accurate electromagnetic precision fire available. Its weapon-learning system and velocity-consistent launch combine to produce accuracy that matches the best chemical-propellant precision rifles while adding the armor-defeat capability of a tungsten penetrator. The plasma trail in humid conditions is a tactical disadvantage that reveals the firing position, but in dry environments the weapon's signature is minimal.
cultural_context: The Thunderbolt is the ultimate expression of Volkov-Saito's precision philosophy applied to emerging technology. Its Φ40,000+ price tag and vetted-customer-only sales create an exclusivity that borders on mystique. In precision shooting circles, the Thunderbolt is spoken of with reverence — a weapon that represents the current peak of individual precision capability. Owning one is a statement of both wealth and skill.
story_hooks: A Thunderbolt appeared on the black market with its weapon-learning data intact. The data reveals the firing patterns of its original owner — a classified military marksman whose identity is now compromised.
Volkov-Saito's vetting process was penetrated by an intelligence agency that used a front company to purchase six Thunderbolts. The weapons are now in the hands of an assassination cell.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular precision rifle with an aggressive forward-swept design. The profile suggests compressed power—lean and purposeful, with a distinctive raised receiver spine and prominent coil housings along the barrel. Visually aggressive despite its lack of mechanical bulk.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 118 cm | Barrel length: 71 cm | Width across coil housing: 8.2 cm | Height from grip to scope rail: 12 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light for its capability—5.5 kg feels balanced and controllable, though the forward weight distribution demands respect. The separate power cell backpack (3.0 kg) shifts the weapon system's center of gravity noticeably rearward when fully integrated.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade carbon composite frame with integrated electromagnetic coil housing; tungsten-reinforced receiver sections at stress points; brushed titanium alloy barrel jacket
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray primary finish with anodized black accents on the coil housing. High-polish titanium barrel details catch light sharply. Wear-resistant ceramic coating on all friction surfaces—resists scoring even under heavy use.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray base with deep charcoal black coil housings; brushed titanium highlights on barrel jacket and control surfaces. Subtle blue accent lighting on capacitor status indicators.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured rubber composite grip with integrated microstructure for enhanced purchase, even when wet. Stippled texture mimics the grip of precision Earth-era rifles, providing intuitive hand familiarity. Subtle thermal feedback through grip material indicates capacitor charge state.
distinctive_features: Pronounced dual electromagnetic coil housings running parallel along barrel—visible magnetic field distortion shimmer in certain lighting
Integrated rail-mounted targeting computer with holographic display interface (mounted above receiver)
Four small status LEDs on receiver spine—red/amber/green for power and weapon-learning algorithm status
Cooling fins on coil housings designed to dissipate capacitor discharge heat
Custom serial-lock mechanism integrated into magazine well—physically prevents installation of unauthorized power cells
Faint grid-pattern etching on side panels from precision manufacturing tolerances
Minimal muzzle brake design—electromagnetic discharge vents rather than traditional ports
Weapon-learning data port (covered by armored flip cap) on left receiver side
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VOLKOV-SAITO PRECISION logo etched in chrome on upper receiver in precise Cyrillic-influenced typography. Serial number and individual weapon-learning ID code engraved into titanium barrel shroud—unique to each unit. Small certification hologram mounted below charging port indicating tier/authorization level.
physical_description.condition_typical: Meticulously maintained. Precision weapons demand care—scuff marks are rare, coil housings show no corrosion. Black anodize remains crisp. Capacitor dust covers show careful handling. Well-maintained examples look almost clinical in their pristine state; even heavily-used units maintain immaculate appearance due to their elite owner demographics.
